MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Anker hub's SD and microSD slots connect directly to my repeated memory-card use and give me a concrete reason to consider it.",
    "Offering a transfer accessory fits my history of buying readers, cables and mounts to support devices I already use, though I would need to confirm USB-C compatibility and its usefulness beyond my existing reader."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The NVMe drives and enclosure concern storage, but they solve computer-drive needs rather than the removable camera-card needs shown in my history.",
    "The smart display, security bundle, laptop and modem require new needs that I have not expressed; buying photography accessories or a tablet does not make those natural next purchases.",
    "The LENTION hub and USB-C cable depend on connections I have not established that I use, while my previous cables served specific Micro USB, Mini USB and older Apple devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My memory-card purchases seem to have been treated as interest in storage of any kind, overlooking what the storage needs to fit and do.",
    "My purchases across electronics seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest broadly related devices, even when they serve different purposes from my existing equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories for particular devices, so connector type, fit and the exact job an accessory performs matter to my choice.",
    "I already have a dual-slot card reader; another reader needs a useful added capability rather than simply repeating something I own.",
    "My repeated tripod, memory-card and recent lens-cap purchases give stronger reasons to consider photography accessories than computer upgrades or connected-home devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my need for useful accessories but stretched that into unrelated storage upgrades and new devices without enough evidence of need or compatibility."
}
